name: Orbit
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="3">
    <description>
                                                                                                      This is a test of an rd that uses an iteration step implemented to treat reagents a and b as a complex number (a+bi) and raising it to a power.;
[link]</a>
    </description>
    <rule name="Orbit" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="clampMin">
        -20
      </param>
      <param name="clampMax">
        20
      </param>
      <param name="constReal">
        0.32397
      </param>
      <param name="constImag">
        -0.00296
      </param>
      <param name="realPower">
        2
      </param>
      <param name="imagPower">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.2
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.2
      </param>
      <param name="mag_amp">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="mag_power">
        0.5
      </param>
      <param name="mag_add">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="phase_offset">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="phase_scale">
        1
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="4">
                c = pow( a*a + b*b, mag_power) * mag_amp + mag_add;
d = atan2( b, a ) * phase_scale + phase_offset;
//delta_a = clamp( timestep * pow( c, realPower) * pow( 2.718281828459045235360287471352, -imagPower*d ) * cos( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d ) + D_a * laplacian_a + constReal, clampMin, clampMax );
//delta_b = clamp( timestep * pow( c, realPower) * pow( 2.718281828459045235360287471352, -imagPower*d ) * sin( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d ) + D_b * laplacian_b + constImag, clampMin, clampMax );
//a = clamp( timestep * pow( c, realPower) * pow( 2.718281828459045235360287471352, -imagPower*d ) * cos( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d ) + D_a * laplacian_a + constReal, clampMin, clampMax );
//b = clamp( timestep * pow( c, realPower) * pow( 2.718281828459045235360287471352, -imagPower*d ) * sin( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d ) + D_b * laplacian_b + constImag, clampMin, clampMax );
delta_a = clamp( timestep * (-a + pow( c, realPower) * pow( 2.718281828459045235360287471352, -imagPower*d ) * cos( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d ) + constReal), clampMin, clampMax ) + D_a * laplacian_a;
delta_b = clamp( timestep * (-b + pow( c, realPower) * pow( 2.718281828459045235360287471352, -imagPower*d ) * sin( imagPower * log( c ) + realPower * d ) + constImag), clampMin, clampMax ) + D_b * laplacian_b;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="false">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite>
          
        </overwrite>
        <linear_gradient val1="-2" val2="2">

          <point3D x="1" y="0" z="0">

        <everywhere>

      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite>

          </point3D>

        <everywhere>
